verses.en: For the kingdom of heaven is like unto a man that is an householder, which went out early in the morning to hire labourers into his vineyard.
verses.pt: Pois o reino dos céus é semelhante a um homem, dono de propriedade, que saiu de madrugada para empregar trabalhadores para a sua vinha.
verses.en_web: “For the Kingdom of Heaven is like a man who was the master of a household, who went out early in the morning to hire laborers for his vineyard.
verses.en_bbe: For the kingdom of heaven is like the master of a house, who went out early in the morning to get workers into his vine-garden.

verses.en: And when he had agreed with the labourers for a penny a day, he sent them into his vineyard.
verses.pt: Ele entrou em acordo com os trabalhadores por um denário ao dia, e os mandou à sua vinha.
verses.en_web: When he had agreed with the laborers for a denarius a day, he sent them into his vineyard.
verses.en_bbe: And when he had made an agreement with the workmen for a penny a day, he sent them into his vine-garden.

verses.en: And he went out about the third hour, and saw others standing idle in the marketplace,
verses.pt: E quando saiu perto da hora terceira, viu outros que estavam desocupados na praça.
verses.en_web: He went out about the third hour, and saw others standing idle in the marketplace.
verses.en_bbe: And he went out about the third hour, and saw others in the market-place doing nothing;

verses.en: And said unto them; Go ye also into the vineyard, and whatsoever is right I will give you. And they went their way.
verses.pt: Então disse-lhes: “Ide vós também à vinha, e vos darei o que for justo”. E eles foram.
verses.en_web: He said to them, ‘You also go into the vineyard, and whatever is right I will give you.’ So they went their way.
verses.en_bbe: And he said to them, Go into the vine-garden with the others, and whatever is right I will give you. And they went to work.

verses.en: Again he went out about the sixth and ninth hour, and did likewise.
verses.pt: Saindo novamente perto da hora sexta e nona, fez o mesmo.
verses.en_web: Again he went out about the sixth and the ninth hour, and did likewise.
verses.en_bbe: Again he went out about the sixth and the ninth hour, and did the same.

verses.en: And about the eleventh hour he went out, and found others standing idle, and saith unto them, Why stand ye here all the day idle?
verses.pt: E quando saiu perto da décima primeira hora, achou outros que estavam desocupados, e lhes perguntou: “Por que estais aqui o dia todo desocupados?”
verses.en_web: About the eleventh hour he went out, and found others standing idle. He said to them, ‘Why do you stand here all day idle?’
verses.en_bbe: And about the eleventh hour he went out and saw others doing nothing; and he says to them, Why are you here all the day doing nothing?

verses.en: They say unto him, Because no man hath hired us. He saith unto them, Go ye also into the vineyard; and whatsoever is right, that shall ye receive.
verses.pt: Eles lhe disseram: “Porque ninguém nos empregou”. Ele lhes respondeu: “Ide vós também à vinha, e recebereis o que for justo”.
verses.en_web: “They said to him, ‘Because no one has hired us.’ “He said to them, ‘You also go into the vineyard, and you will receive whatever is right.’
verses.en_bbe: They say to him, Because no man has given us work. He says to them, Go in with the rest, into the vine-garden.

verses.en: So when even was come, the lord of the vineyard saith unto his steward, Call the labourers, and give them their hire, beginning from the last unto the first.
verses.pt: E chegando o anoitecer, o senhor da vinha disse ao seu mordomo: “Chama aos trabalhadores, e paga-lhes o salário, começando dos últimos, até os primeiros”.
verses.en_web: When evening had come, the lord of the vineyard said to his manager, ‘Call the laborers and pay them their wages, beginning from the last to the first.’
verses.en_bbe: And when evening came, the lord of the vine-garden said to his manager, Let the workers come, and give them their payment, from the last to the first.

verses.en: And when they came that were hired about the eleventh hour, they received every man a penny.
verses.pt: Então vieram os de cerca da hora décima primeira, e receberam um denário cada um.
verses.en_web: “When those who were hired at about the eleventh hour came, they each received a denarius.
verses.en_bbe: And when those men came who had gone to work at the eleventh hour, they were given every man a penny.

verses.en: But when the first came, they supposed that they should have received more; and they likewise received every man a penny.
verses.pt: Quando os primeiros vieram, pensavam que receberiam mais; porém eles também receberam um denário cada um.
verses.en_web: When the first came, they supposed that they would receive more; and they likewise each received a denarius.
verses.en_bbe: Then those who came first had the idea that they would get more; and they, like the rest, were given a penny.

verses.en: And when they had received it, they murmured against the goodman of the house,
verses.pt: Assim, ao receberem, murmuraram contra o chefe de casa,
verses.en_web: When they received it, they murmured against the master of the household,
verses.en_bbe: And when they got it, they made a protest against the master of the house,

verses.en: Saying, These last have wrought but one hour, and thou hast made them equal unto us, which have borne the burden and heat of the day.
verses.pt: dizendo: “Estes últimos trabalharam uma única hora, e tu os igualaste conosco, que suportamos a carga e o calor do dia”.
verses.en_web: saying, ‘These last have spent one hour, and you have made them equal to us, who have borne the burden of the day and the scorching heat!’
verses.en_bbe: Saying, These last have done only one hour's work, and you have made them equal to us, who have undergone the hard work of the day and the burning heat.

verses.en: But he answered one of them, and said, Friend, I do thee no wrong: didst not thou agree with me for a penny?
verses.pt: Ele, porém, respondeu a um deles: “Amigo, nada de errado estou fazendo contigo. Não concordaste tu comigo por um denário?
verses.en_web: “But he answered one of them, ‘Friend, I am doing you no wrong. Didn’t you agree with me for a denarius?
verses.en_bbe: But he in answer said to one of them, Friend, I do you no wrong: did you not make an agreement with me for a penny?

verses.en: Take that thine is, and go thy way: I will give unto this last, even as unto thee.
verses.pt: Toma o que é teu, e vai embora; e quero dar a este último tanto quanto a ti.
verses.en_web: Take that which is yours, and go your way. It is my desire to give to this last just as much as to you.
verses.en_bbe: Take what is yours, and go away; it is my pleasure to give to this last, even as to you.

verses.en: Is it not lawful for me to do what I will with mine own? Is thine eye evil, because I am good?
verses.pt: Acaso não me é lícito fazer do que é meu o que eu quiser? Ou o teu olho é mau, porque eu sou bom?”
verses.en_web: Isn’t it lawful for me to do what I want to with what I own? Or is your eye evil, because I am good?’
verses.en_bbe: Have I not the right to do as seems good to me in my house? or is your eye evil, because I am good?

verses.en: So the last shall be first, and the first last: for many be called, but few chosen.
verses.pt: Assim os últimos serão primeiros; e os primeiros, últimos; pois muitos são chamados, mas poucos escolhidos.
verses.en_web: So the last will be first, and the first last. For many are called, but few are chosen.”
verses.en_bbe: So the last will be first, and the first last.

verses.en: And Jesus going up to Jerusalem took the twelve disciples apart in the way, and said unto them,
verses.pt: E enquanto Jesus subia a Jerusalém, tomou consigo os doze discípulos à parte no caminho, e lhes disse:
verses.en_web: As Jesus was going up to Jerusalem, he took the twelve disciples aside, and on the way he said to them,
verses.en_bbe: And when Jesus was going up to Jerusalem, he took the twelve disciples on one side, and said to them,

verses.en: Behold, we go up to Jerusalem; and the Son of man shall be betrayed unto the chief priests and unto the scribes, and they shall condemn him to death,
verses.pt: Eis que estamos subindo a Jerusalém, e o Filho do homem será entregue aos chefes dos sacerdotes e aos escribas, e o condenarão à morte.
verses.en_web: “Behold, we are going up to Jerusalem, and the Son of Man will be delivered to the chief priests and scribes, and they will condemn him to death,
verses.en_bbe: See, we go up to Jerusalem; and the Son of man will be given into the hands of the chief priests and scribes; and they will give orders for him to be put to death,

verses.en: And shall deliver him to the Gentiles to mock, and to scourge, and to crucify him: and the third day he shall rise again.
verses.pt: E o entregarão aos gentios, para que dele escarneçam, e o açoitem, e crucifiquem; mas ao terceiro dia ressuscitará.
verses.en_web: and will hand him over to the Gentiles to mock, to scourge, and to crucify; and the third day he will be raised up.”
verses.en_bbe: And will give him up to the Gentiles to be made sport of and to be whipped and to be put to death on the cross: and the third day he will come back again from the dead.

verses.en: Then came to him the mother of Zebedee’s children with her sons, worshipping him, and desiring a certain thing of him.
verses.pt: Então se aproximou dele a mãe dos filhos de Zebedeu, com os seus filhos. Ela o adorou para lhe pedir algo.
verses.en_web: Then the mother of the sons of Zebedee came to him with her sons, kneeling and asking a certain thing of him.
verses.en_bbe: Then the mother of the sons of Zebedee came to him with her sons, giving him worship and making a request of him.

verses.en: And he said unto her, What wilt thou? She saith unto him, Grant that these my two sons may sit, the one on thy right hand, and the other on the left, in thy kingdom.
verses.pt: E ele lhe perguntou: O que queres? Ela lhe disse: Dá ordem para que estes meus dois filhos se sentem, um à tua direita e outro à tua esquerda, no teu Reino.
verses.en_web: He said to her, “What do you want?” She said to him, “Command that these, my two sons, may sit, one on your right hand, and one on your left hand, in your Kingdom.”
verses.en_bbe: And he said to her, What is your desire? She says to him, Let my two sons be seated, the one at your right hand, and the other at your left, in your kingdom.

verses.en: But Jesus answered and said, Ye know not what ye ask. Are ye able to drink of the cup that I shall drink of, and to be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with? They say unto him, We are able.
verses.pt: Porém Jesus respondeu: Não sabeis o que pedis. Podeis vós beber o cálice que eu beberei, e ser batizados com o batismo com que eu sou batizado? Eles lhe disseram: Podemos.
verses.en_web: But Jesus answered, “You don’t know what you are asking. Are you able to drink the cup that I am about to drink, and be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with?” They said to him, “We are able.”
verses.en_bbe: But Jesus made answer and said, You have no idea what you are requesting. Are you able to take of the cup which I am about to take?

verses.en: And he saith unto them, Ye shall drink indeed of my cup, and be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with: but to sit on my right hand, and on my left, is not mine to give, but it shall be given to them for whom it is prepared of my Father.
verses.pt: E ele lhes disse: De fato meu cálice bebereis, e com o batismo com que eu sou batizado sereis batizados; mas sentar-se à minha direita, e à minha esquerda, não me cabe concedê-lo, mas será para os que por meu Pai está preparado.
verses.en_web: He said to them, “You will indeed drink my cup, and be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with, but to sit on my right hand and on my left hand is not mine to give; but it is for whom it has been prepared by my Father.”
verses.en_bbe: They say to him, We are able. He says to them, Truly, you will take of my cup: but to be seated at my right hand and at my left is not for me to give, but it is for those for whom my Father has made it ready.

verses.en: And when the ten heard it, they were moved with indignation against the two brethren.
verses.pt: E quando os dez ouviram isso,indignaram-se contra os dois irmãos.
verses.en_web: When the ten heard it, they were indignant with the two brothers.
verses.en_bbe: And when it came to the ears of the ten, they were angry with the two brothers.

verses.en: But Jesus called them unto him, and said, Ye know that the princes of the Gentiles exercise dominion over them, and they that are great exercise authority upon them.
verses.pt: Então Jesus os chamou a si, e disse: Vós bem sabeis que os chefes dos gentios os dominam, e os grandes usam de autoridade sobre eles.
verses.en_web: But Jesus summoned them, and said, “You know that the rulers of the nations lord it over them, and their great ones exercise authority over them.
verses.en_bbe: But Jesus said to them, You see that the rulers of the Gentiles are lords over them, and their great ones have authority over them.

verses.en: But it shall not be so among you: but whosoever will be great among you, let him be your minister;
verses.pt: Mas não será assim entre vós. Ao contrário, quem quiser se tornar grande entre vós seja o vosso assistente;
verses.en_web: It shall not be so among you, but whoever desires to become great among you shall be your servant.
verses.en_bbe: Let it not be so among you: but if anyone has a desire to become great among you, let him be your servant;

verses.en: And whosoever will be chief among you, let him be your servant:
verses.pt: e quem quiser ser o primeiro entre vós seja o vosso servo;
verses.en_web: Whoever desires to be first among you shall be your bondservant,
verses.en_bbe: And whoever has a desire to be first among you, let him take the lowest place:

verses.en: Even as the Son of man came not to be ministered unto, but to minister, and to give his life a ransom for many.
verses.pt: assim como o Filho do homem não veio para ser servido, mas sim para servir, e para dar a sua vida em resgate por muitos.
verses.en_web: even as the Son of Man came not to be served, but to serve, and to give his life as a ransom for many.”
verses.en_bbe: Even as the Son of man did not come to have servants, but to be a servant, and to give his life for the salvation of men.

verses.en: And as they departed from Jericho, a great multitude followed him.
verses.pt: Quando eles saíram de Jericó, uma grande multidão o seguiu.
verses.en_web: As they went out from Jericho, a great multitude followed him.
verses.en_bbe: And when they were going out from Jericho, a great number went after him.

verses.en: And, behold, two blind men sitting by the way side, when they heard that Jesus passed by, cried out, saying, Have mercy on us, O Lord, thou Son of David.
verses.pt: E eis que dois cegos assentados junto ao caminho, ao ouvirem que Jesus passava, clamaram: Senhor, Filho de Davi, tem misericórdia de nós!
verses.en_web: Behold, two blind men sitting by the road, when they heard that Jesus was passing by, cried out, “Lord, have mercy on us, you son of David!”
verses.en_bbe: And two blind men seated by the wayside, when they had the news that Jesus was going by, gave a loud cry, saying, Lord, Son of David, have mercy on us.

verses.en: And the multitude rebuked them, because they should hold their peace: but they cried the more, saying, Have mercy on us, O Lord, thou Son of David.
verses.pt: E a multidão os repreendia, para que se calassem, mas eles clamavam ainda mais: Senhor, Filho de Davi, tem misericórdia de nós!
verses.en_web: The multitude rebuked them, telling them that they should be quiet, but they cried out even more, “Lord, have mercy on us, you son of David!”
verses.en_bbe: And the people gave them orders to be quiet; but they went on crying even louder, Lord, Son of David, have mercy on us.

verses.en: And Jesus stood still, and called them, and said, What will ye that I shall do unto you?
verses.pt: Então Jesus parou, chamou-os, e perguntou: Que quereis que eu vos faça?
verses.en_web: Jesus stood still, and called them, and asked, “What do you want me to do for you?”
verses.en_bbe: And Jesus, stopping, sent for them, and said, What would you have me do to you?

verses.en: They say unto him, Lord, that our eyes may be opened.
verses.pt: Eles lhe responderam: Senhor, que nossos olhos sejam abertos.
verses.en_web: They told him, “Lord, that our eyes may be opened.”
verses.en_bbe: They say to him, Lord, that our eyes may be open.

verses.en: So Jesus had compassion on them, and touched their eyes: and immediately their eyes received sight, and they followed him.
verses.pt: E Jesus, compadecido deles, tocou-lhes os olhos. E logo os olhos deles enxergaram, e o seguiram.
verses.en_web: Jesus, being moved with compassion, touched their eyes; and immediately their eyes received their sight, and they followed him.
verses.en_bbe: And Jesus, being moved with pity, put his fingers on their eyes: and straight away they were able to see, and went after him.
